data.name: Parashuram
data.gender_notes: Parashuram is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit paraśu, 'axe', + Rāma — 'Rama with the axe'. Its root is Sanskrit paraśu + rāma. Parashurama, the sixth avatar of Vishnu. Parashuram is a Sanskrit name meaning “Rama with the axe”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Parashuram expresses “Rama with the axe”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit paraśu, 'axe', + Rāma — 'Rama with the axe'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Parashuram total 44, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
